\begin{document}
With a gap $\Delta>0$ and real $\omega$, the quasiparticle energy has the high-frequency tail, as $\omega\to\pm\infty$,
\begin{equation}
\sqrt{\omega^2+\Delta^2} = \omega + \frac{\Delta^2}{2\omega} + O(\omega^{-3}) .
\label{eq:tail}
\end{equation}
